name: Qa Learning Resources
headline: QA Learning Resources: Testing Courses & Guides
short_description: A curated list of high-quality learning platforms, courses, YouTube channels, and certification resources for QA Engineers. both Manual and Automation. Includes free and paid options to help testers at all levels build skills in testing.
author: AlexKuchkov

sections.overview:
QA Learning Resources is a curated collection of online courses, YouTube channels, and certification programs designed for QA engineers at all levels. It aggregates both free and paid learning platforms including Test Automation University, Ministry of Testing, Udemy, and Coursera, covering manual testing, automation frameworks, Selenium, Cypress, API testing, and ISTQB certification prep. The directory includes 10+ YouTube channels from industry experts like Joe Colantonio and Naveen AutomationLabs, offering tutorials on Java, TestNG, Jenkins, and real-world QA practices. Whether you're starting as a manual tester or advancing in automation, this resource helps you identify structured learning paths and certification options.
Finding free Selenium and Cypress automation tutorials for beginners
Identifying ISTQB certification preparation courses and practice exams
Discovering YouTube channels for manual testing and test case writing
Locating paid platforms like Ministry of Testing for advanced QA skills
